offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures auto-dimming rearview mirrors, driver-assist and camera-based electronics, and interior sensing and connectivity systems for automakers. Also makes dimmable aircraft windows and fire protection products for commercial customers.

primary_products.value: auto-dimming rearview mirrors; camera and driver-assist modules; electrochromic aircraft windows; smoke alarms and fire protection devices; interior sensing and connectivity systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: global automakers and their tier suppliers, aircraft manufacturers, fire protection distributors and contractors

end_markets.value: automotive; aerospace; fire protection; commercial buildings

revenue_model.value: product sales: electronic mirrors and automotive systems sold to automakers, aircraft windows and fire protection products

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: manufactures electro-optical components and systems from purchased materials, sold to automakers and aircraft makers; OEM / manufacturer: builds fire protection devices sold to distributors and contractors

geography_served.value: global: Customers in North America, Europe and Asia, manufacturing in Michigan and abroad

specialization.value: related lines: Automotive mirrors and electronics as core, plus dimmable aircraft windows and fire protection products

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct to automakers and tier suppliers, and aircraft manufacturers; distributors / dealers: fire protection products via distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Automotive safety standards (NHTSA, FMVSS), aviation certification (FAA) and fire product listings (UL, NFPA)
